about: Dragon Star Varnir™ takes place in a world where witches are cursed to give birth to dragons.
One man tasked with hunting them soon finds his own fate intertwined with his former enemies.
Fight against dragons in turn-based, mid-air combat, using tiers, transformations, and more to weaken them and devour their abilities.
Raise three young witches and choose to save them or sacrifice them to gain items and skills.
The decisions you make will change the course of the story!
This product supports the following languages: English
Remote Play allows users to connect to and play games on their PlayStation®4 or PlayStation®5 using a mobile device, PC, or another PlayStation®4 or PlayStation®5.
One-time licence fee to download to multiple PS4 systems. Sign in to PlayStation is not required to use this on your primary PS4, but is required for use on other PS4 systems.
